title: Combining a convolutional neural network with autoencoders to predict the survival chance of COVID-19 patients
summary: A retrospective 320-patient clinical dataset study reports CNN-AE mortality/survival classification performance; primary journal text and arXiv v1 confirm the result existed before publication, with severe class imbalance and no prospective clinical evaluation.
ai_technology: CNN; convolutional neural network; neural network
